name: create_health_endpoint_dotnet
description: Creates an ASP.NET Core minimal API health-check endpoint
prompts: This is an ASP.NET Core minimal API project (app.csproj targets net8.0). Write Program.cs to add a GET /health endpoint that returns JSON {"status": "ok"}. Have it listen on http://0.0.0.0:8005.

test_setup_files.test_health.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, glob, urllib.request, urllib.error
subprocess.run(['dotnet', 'build', '-c', 'Release', '-o', 'out'], check=True)
dlls = glob.glob('out/*.dll')
dll = [d for d in dlls if 'app' in d.lower()][0]
srv = subprocess.Popen(['dotnet', dll])
try:
    body = None
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8005/health', timeout=1) as resp:
                assert resp.status == 200, f'expected 200, got {resp.status}'
                body = json.loads(resp.read())
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert body is not None, 'server never became reachable on :8005'
    assert body.get('status') == 'ok', f'unexpected body: {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
